content: Snipe-IT distinguishes: Licenses (seats derived from seat count field, each seat checkout links to a user or asset, tracks expiration date, reclaim on checkin), Accessories (non-serialized, checked out 1-per-transaction to a user only, quantity decremented from pool), Consumables (non-serialized, consumed/allocated to a user, quantity tracked, no expectation of return), Components (attached to a specific asset, e.g. RAM/HDD upgrade, quantity-aware checkout to assets). Known product gap: accessories/consumables checkout quantity is limited to 1 per transaction in core Snipe-IT (long-standing feature request, unresolved as of 2026).
